# IBaseSwapArkEvents
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/events/arks/IBaseSwapArkEvents.sol)

**Title:**
IBaseSwapArkEvents

Events emitted by swap-based Ark contracts


## Events
### SlippageUpdated
Emitted when the allowed swap slippage is updated


```solidity
event SlippageUpdated(Percentage newSlippagePercentage);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`newSlippagePercentage`|`Percentage`|The new maximum slippage percentage applied to swaps|
